name: Nestle NAN Excellapro
ingredients_raw: Milk solids, Demineralised whey, Soyabean oil, Minerals, Low erucic rapeseed oil, High oleic sunflower oil, Coconut oil, Sunflower oil, Emulsifier (Soya lecithin), Human Milk Oligosaccharides' (2'Fucosyllactose (2'FL) and Lacto-N-Neotetraose (LNnT), Choline bitartrate, Arachidonic acid (ARA) from Mortierella alpina oil, Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) from Schizochytrium sp. oil, Vitamins, Amino acid (L-Phenylalanine), Probiotic Limasilactobacillus reuter), Taurine, Acidity regulators (Citric acid and Potassium hydroxide), Nucleotides, Carnitine and Packaging gases (Carbon dioxide and Nitrogen).
